claims.text: IV dextrose for altered mental status even when serum glucose is normal
claims.quote: For patients with initial mild encephalopathy, neuroglycopenia should be considered. This can occur even with normal serum or capillary glucose measurements. An IV dextrose bolus (0.5-1 g/kg) and/or infusion can mitigate or help resolve mild encephalopathy.
even when systemic hypoglycemia is absent, low brain glucose levels.
